periods.analysis: Free clinics gave 540 doses in Q1, mostly flu and COVID vaccines at libraries and senior housing.
Doses rose only from 540 to 610 after respiratory season ended and spring catch-up clinics drew low turnout.
periods.recommendations: Hold back-to-school immunization clinics at four schools.

periods.analysis: Doses nearly doubled to 1,180 in Q3 with back-to-school clinics at four schools and the airport staff lounge.
periods.recommendations: Hold 12 flu clinics from October to December and send second-dose reminders.
